items.title: Mozambique LNG holds Speed Meeting in Pemba with more than 100 Mozambican companies
items.summary: The Mozambique LNG project, operated by TotalEnergies EP Mozambique Area 1 Limitada (TEPMA1), held a Speed Meeting today in Pemba, bringing together more than 100 Mozambican companies. The Speed Meeting provided participating companies with an opportunity to engage directly with the Mozambique LNG project’s procurement teams, clarify questions regarding contracting processes, and obtain information on… Source
